IceTransportPolicy.description: ICE transport policy advertised to the browser, for example 'all' or 'relay'.

EchoTestDestination.description: Optional echo destination (a number or SIP URI that echoes audio back) used by the audio test and the health canary.

OrphanedCallHandling.description: What to do about a call the connection has up that the platform has no record of: record it and leave it connected, or tell the caller and hang up.

AnsweringMachineDetection.description: How an automated call asks the provider whether a person or a machine answered it.

NoiseSuppressionEngine.description: The Telnyx noise suppression engine started on an agent's leg once it is connected, or 'Off'.

NoiseSuppressionAgentVoice.description: Whether noise suppression cleans the agent's voice, which is what the caller hears.

NoiseSuppressionCallerVoice.description: Whether noise suppression cleans the caller's voice, which is what the agent hears.

NoiseSuppressionStrength.description: How hard the noise suppression engine works on each voice it cleans. 'Balanced' (the default) removes line hiss while keeping the soft endings of words.

TtsVoice.description: Text-to-speech voice used by spoken prompts, either 'female', 'male' or a 'Provider.Model.VoiceId' name such as 'AWS.Polly.Joanna-Neural'.

TtsLanguage.description: Language spoken prompts are said in, for example 'en-US'.

TelnyxSmsSettings.description: Telnyx SMS provider settings, independent of the Telnyx voice settings.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the UI-configured Telnyx SMS provider is enabled.

ApiKey.description: Telnyx API key (v2) presented as a bearer token on the Messaging API. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

MessagingProfileId.description: Optional Telnyx messaging profile identifier used when sending.

WebhookPublicKey.description: Telnyx webhook Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify inbound messaging webhooks. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

ApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override of the Telnyx REST API base address. Empty uses https://api.telnyx.com/v2/.

TwilioSettings.description: Configuration for the Twilio SMS provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the Twilio SMS provider is enabled.

PhoneNumber.description: The Twilio phone number to send SMS messages from.

ConsumerKey.description: The API key (consumer key) from the Twitter developer application.

ConsumerSecret.description: The API secret key (consumer secret) from the Twitter developer application.

AccessToken.description: The access token for authenticating API requests.

AccessTokenSecret.description: The access token secret for authenticating API requests.

CallbackPath.description: The request path where the user-agent will be returned after authentication.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens.

RequireTwoFactorAuthentication.description: Whether to require two-factor authentication for all users.

AllowRememberClientTwoFactorAuthenticati.description: Whether to allow users to remember their two-factor authentication on a device.

NumberOfRecoveryCodesToGenerate.description: The number of recovery codes to generate.

UseSiteTheme.description: Whether to use the site theme for the two-factor authentication pages.

UsaFtcDncRegistrySettings.description: Configuration for the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry provider.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key used to authenticate with the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry.

OrganizationId.description: The USA FTC organization identifier used for registry lookups.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry API.

Required.description: Whether users are required to upload an avatar.

UseDefaultStyle.description: Whether to use the default avatar styling.

WorkflowTrimmingSettings.description: Configuration for automatic trimming of old workflow instances.

RetentionDays.description: The number of days to retain workflow instances before trimming.

Disabled.description: Whether automatic workflow trimming is disabled.

Statuses.description: The workflow statuses to include in trimming.
